entries.title: Lamentations 5:1
segments: Remember, O Jehovah, what is come upon us: Behold, and see our reproach.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:2
segments: Our inheritance is turned unto strangers, Our houses unto aliens.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:3
segments: We are orphans and fatherless; Our mothers are as widows.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:4
segments: We have drunken our water for money; Our wood is sold unto us.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:5
segments: Our pursuers are upon our necks: We are weary, and have no rest.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:6
segments: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, And to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:7
segments: Our fathers sinned, and are not; And we have borne their iniquities.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:8
segments: Servants rule over us: There is none to deliver us out of their hand.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:9
segments: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, Because of the sword of the wilderness.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:10
segments: Our skin is black like an oven, Because of the burning heat of famine.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:11
segments: They ravished the women in Zion, The virgins in the cities of Judah.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:12
segments: Princes were hanged up by their hand: The faces of elders were not honored.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:13
segments: The young men bare the mill; And the children stumbled under the wood.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:14
segments: The elders have ceased from the gate, The young men from their music.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:15
segments: The joy of our heart is ceased; Our dance is turned into mourning.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:16
segments: The crown is fallen from our head: Woe unto us! for we have sinned.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:17
segments: For this our heart is faint; For these things our eyes are dim;

entries.title: Lamentations 5:18
segments: For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate: The foxes walk upon it.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:19
segments: Thou, O Jehovah, abidest for ever; Thy throne is from generation to generation.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:20
segments: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, [And] forsake us so long time?

entries.title: Lamentations 5:21
segments: Turn thou us unto thee, O Jehovah, and we shall be turned; Renew our days as of old.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:22
segments: But thou hast utterly rejected us; Thou art very wroth against us.
